title: PVLedger database specification — draft, portable schema contract
status: Draft v0.7.2 adds four SQLite triggers for actual expense and income posting and current and savings balance history.
scope: Complete SQLite schema (20 tables), income and planned-income timestamp columns, 430 reference seed rows, application conventions, cross-engine mappings and editable descriptions.
database_description: PVLedger personal-finance data including account balance snapshots, income and planned income, expenses, users and roles, accounts, debts, taxes, plugins, settings and reference data.

tables.name: pvl_account_history_current
tables.description: Historical snapshots of the amount of funds held in a current/checking account at a recorded Unix timestamp.

columns.name: id_account
columns.description: Required reference to the current/checking account whose historical balance is recorded.
columns.description_status: user-confirmed NOT NULL correction to v0.6 source

columns.name: date
columns.description: Timestamp when this account balance was recorded; application convention: Unix epoch seconds in UTC.
columns.description_status: user-specified history purpose; field semantics inferred

value_semantics.unit_status: draft convention (SQL affinity does not enforce units)

columns.name: amount
columns.description: Account funds balance at the recorded timestamp, denominated in the currency of the linked account; historical amount, not the live balance.
columns.description_status: user-specified history purpose; field semantics inferred

value_semantics.date_snapshot_rule: Server time when the account balance changed.

tables.source_create_sql: CREATE TABLE "pvl_account_history_current" (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, id_account INTEGER REFERENCES pvl_accounts_current (id) NOT NULL, date INTEGER NOT NULL, amount REAL NOT NULL);
additional_notes: Stores dated account-balance snapshots, not individual account transactions.
date and amount are NOT NULL; the foreign-key account reference is NOT NULL.
No UNIQUE (id_account, date) constraint or supporting (id_account, date) index is declared; duplicate timestamps are allowed.
The snapshot currency is inferred through the associated account; no separate currency column exists.
Confirmed by the latest uploaded pvledger(6).sql: id_account is NOT NULL.

assumptions_and_open_questions: Interest and billing_date calculation conventions remain unspecified; billing_date uses INTEGER UTC Unix epoch seconds as a draft convention.
Planned-expense status codes 0–3 are application-defined; source SQL allows NULL and any other INTEGER, with no CHECK constraint.
Other state-code fields (pvl_plugins.enabled, pvl_settings.demo_mode, pvl_users.is_admin) still need application code mappings.
Role privileges and permission enforcement are not defined by the current schema; users must reference a role.
pvl_settings should contain exactly one row following first-run setup; its singleton invariant is not enforced by SQL (source seeds zero rows).
Define whether initially blank instance_name means SQL NULL or the empty string, and define the lang value format (e.g. BCP 47).
Define db_version string scheme and migration script registry/ordering; do not confuse application/database version with spec document version.
First user is created on first run; no account is seeded. Define signup/bootstrap policy, username validation and initial role selection.
SHA-256 is user-selected, but a fast unsalted digest is unsafe for password authentication; consider migrating to Argon2id, scrypt, or bcrypt.
Financial amounts are SQLite REAL; use fixed-precision values in a separately approved change if financial correctness requires it.
Source currency ISO column is nullable even though all seed codes are present; SQLite UNIQUE index allows multiple NULLs.
The country ISO code has no UNIQUE constraint, despite seeded values being distinct.
Imported country/currency names are preserved as supplied; multilingual name variants and special-purpose codes may need separate localization records.
SQLite requires PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON on application connections; FK ON DELETE/UPDATE actions default to NO ACTION.
Specify recurrence rules for pvl_expenses_recurring and date/amount update workflows.
No history indexes on (id_account, date); add only with a future approved schema revision if needed.
v0.6 initialization dropped DROP TABLE statements; seed INSERTs still use fixed IDs and will fail on rerun against an initialized database.
v0.6.1 requires historical current-account id_account NOT NULL. If migrating a populated v0.6 database, resolve any existing NULL account references before rebuilding the table.
Define pvl_income.status allowed values and the transitions between states; the SQL requires INTEGER but has no CHECK or mapping.
Define pvl_income_planned.status allowed values and whether they share semantics with planned expenses; do not assume the 0–3 planned expense codes apply.
Define if planned income becomes actual income through a relationship or application workflow; the SQL declares no link between the two tables.
Both income tables store amount REAL and reference an account, not a currency; define currency, sign, precision, and conversion behavior in application code.

The two income date columns are required INTEGER Unix time. Exact meaning of actual vs planned income timestamp (receipt date, scheduled payment, etc.) is application-defined; seconds in UTC are a draft convention.

A v0.7 database with populated income tables cannot add these NOT NULL date fields without providing accurate historical timestamps for those existing records. Do not invent dates or silently drop records.
Define history retention and correction procedures for posted transactions.
